title: A translation-invariant integer multiplicity current whose tangent planes contain L is a product: S = [[L]] × S₀ with S₀ supported in L^⊥
statement:
Data:
- P, n ∈ ℕ; L ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with 1 ≤ d := dim L < n; m := n − d.
- f = (f_1, …, f_d) an orthonormal family in L (hence an orthonormal basis of L).
- S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and an integer multiplicity representation R = (M, θ, ξ) of S (IMRep univ n, R.Represents S); μ := R.measure.
Hypotheses:
- S is invariant under translations by L: currentEval (blowUp S (−v) 1) ω = S ω, i.e. S(ω(v + ·)) = S(ω), for v ∈ L and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P).
- For μ-a.e. x, the projection p_x onto approxTangentPlane n M x fixes every v ∈ L.
Conclusion: there are S₀ ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) and an integer multiplicity representation R₀ of S₀ (IMRep univ m) such that:
- spt S₀ ⊆ L^⊥;
- μ₀ := R₀.measure satisfies μ₀(ℝ^P ∖ L^⊥) = 0;
- μ(A) = ∫_L μ₀(A − t) dH^d(t) for every Borel A, written ∫⁻ t in L, μ₀((fun y => t + y)⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[d];
- product formula: let ♭ : Λ^n → Λ^m be any map with (♭α)(v) = α(f_1, …, f_d, v_1, …, v_m) (Lean: α (Fin.append f v ∘ Fin.cast _)). Then for every test n-form ω,
 S(ω) = ∫_L currentEval S₀ (y ↦ ♭(ω(t + y))) dH^d(t).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (f : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ L) → Euclid P) (hd : Module.finrank ℝ L < n), 0 < Module.finrank ℝ L → Orthonormal ℝ f → (∀ i, f i ∈ L) → (∀ v ∈ L, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, currentEval (blowUp S (-v) 1 one_ne_zero) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = S ω) → R.Represents S → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ v ∈ L, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection v = v) → ∃ (S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)) (R₀ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)), R₀.Represents S₀ ∧ S₀.support ⊆ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ R₀.measure (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∫⁻ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), R₀.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]) ∧ ∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n → Covector (Euclid P) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L), (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin (n - Module.finrank ℝ L) → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append f v ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_sub_of_le hd.le).symm)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, S ω = ∫ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), currentEval S₀ (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t + y))) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]
